parent_objective: implement artifact-only diagnosis for repeated matched-budget readiness-floor failure
blocked_by: M2237 admits artifact-only implementation and keeps new rollout/training blocked

public_gates: M2238 must operate only on existing M2230/M2234 artifacts
M2238 must emit row, seed, budget-delta, and training-plateau diagnostics
M2238 must classify the next route without ranking profiles
M2238 must not run training, reset, rollout, measured execution, replay, PPO, or private holdout
M2238 must not claim finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: computes artifact-only readiness-floor, seed-fragility, budget-response, and plateau diagnostics
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: artifact diagnosis only; no rerun ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if required artifacts are missing
stop if diagnosis cannot classify a route
stop if implementation would require new rollout
fallback_plan: write artifact-gap report if inputs are insufficient
route to task/curriculum repair design if seed/task heterogeneity dominates
route to checkpoint selection or reward/floor audit if plateau/floor signals dominate

admission_evidence: M2230 and M2234 artifacts exist and are finite
allowed_updates: M2238 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by result
next_stage_criteria: next audit or repair route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2238 diagnoses readiness artifacts and does not test causal history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, zero-history, or measured execution intervention is run in M2238.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Diagnosis must route weak evidence to task/curriculum/floor/plateau repair rather than lowering self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: reuses existing training artifacts to explain repeated below-floor readiness
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide whether the paper route needs task/curriculum repair or checkpoint/floor calibration
must_synthesize_if: M2238 would imply another blind budget escalation

hypothesis: Existing M2230/M2234 artifacts are sufficient to classify the repeated below-floor readiness failure into seed/task, plateau, floor, or reward/curriculum routes without rerun.
success_criteria: no new reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: implementation ranks profiles or starts new rollout/training
decision_rule: M2238 passes if it produces artifact-only diagnostics and a non-ranking route classification.
